# agentica-tui

> A terminal UI library for Agentica: a typed view tree, an Elm-like loop, and key, mouse, paste and resize events, on termbox2.

Import it with `import TUI from "pkg/tui/tui"`. Build a view with `TUI.text`, `row`, `col`, `box` and `spacer`, run it with `TUI.run(app)` (a `TUI.App` of model, update, view and subscriptions; effects are `Cmd` and `Sub` values), and test views without a terminal with `TUI.layout`. `TUI.Raw` is the terminal by hand (open, cells, present, events). Linux x86_64 only; the package ships its termbox2 library.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, a first program, run it.
- [View tree](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/view-tree.md): text, row, col, box, spacer, layout and widths.
- [Elm loop](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/elm-loop.md): TUI.run, App, Step, Cmd (Run, Quit) and Sub (Tick, Events).
- [Events](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/events.md): keys, mouse, paste (never confirm on a paste) and resize.
- [Styles](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/styles.md): colors, attributes and merge.
- [Low level](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/low-level.md): TUI.Raw: cells, present, waiting for events, render, tasks and locks.
- [Native library](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/native.md): the vendored termbox2, the .so, its sha256 and how CI builds it.
- [Tests](https://github.com/agentica-lang/agentica-tui/blob/main/docs/tests.md): the test suites and how to test a view.
